Causes of Riceyness in Cauliflower in Cauliflower: surface of the curd is loose & has velvety appearance due to elongation of pedicel and form  small white flower buds at the curding stage

Riceyness occurs when the curd starts producing small premature flower buds, making the curd loose and grainy.

Main Causes

High temperature during curd formation.

Excess nitrogen fertilization leading to rapid growth.

Improper variety for the season or climate.

Late harvesting of the curd.

Moisture stress or irregular irrigation.

High humidity with warm weather conditions.
 These factors cause premature floral development, resulting in a loose, granular curd instead of a compact head
